## Objective
- Build a playable 2D chessboard-themed king-with-shotgun vs. Omni Rook boss fight.
- Add mobile controls, a rainbow rook with rainbow trail, a parry technique, and more boss attacks.

## Requirements
- Complete playable game; no clarification questions.
- User specifically requested: “Make mobile controls and make rook rainbow having a rainbow trail also add parry technique and more attacks for omni rook”.

## Decisions
- The game is an arcade boss fight on a chessboard, not standard chess rules.
- Mobile controls use an on-screen movement joystick and Fire/Parry buttons.
- Parry is also mapped to Shift on keyboard.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the base game in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`: movement, shotgun, boss attacks, lives, ammo, scoring, pause, sound, and win/lose/restart.
- Added touch-control UI and CSS, including a virtual joystick and Fire/Parry buttons.
- Added initial parry logic: brief invulnerability, nearby enemy-shot deflection, score bonus, feedback toast, and Shift/touch activation.
- Ran `node --check game.js` successfully before the latest edits; opened the game in browser and captured screenshots.

### Active
- Finish the requested rainbow rook and rainbow trail.
- Add more Omni Rook attack patterns and integrate their tell/fire/collision logic.
- Test the latest mobile controls and parry implementation; recent edits have not yet been syntax-checked or browser-tested.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue `game.js` from the partial parry/touch-control edits; implement rainbow rook and trail visuals.
2. Add multiple new boss attack types and support their telegraphs, projectiles, and damage/collision.
3. Review touch control usability and parry behavior; run `node --check game.js` and browser checks.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, attacks, controls, rendering; contains in-progress touch controls and parry changes.
- `index.html`: Game UI and newly added touch-control elements.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- Latest edits to `game.js` added `parryClock`, `parryActive`, `trailClock`, `rookTrail`; `parry()` and `showToast()`; joystick, fire, and parry button handlers; and Shift key mapping.
- Current `update()` does not yet update parry timers or use `parryActive`; reflected projectiles are not yet handled as player damage to the boss.
- Boss only has existing `line` and radial `burst` attack types. Rook rendering is still red and has no trail.

- Build a playable chessboard-themed arcade boss fight: a king with a shotgun versus the Omni Rook.
- Add mobile controls, a rainbow rook and trail, parrying, and more boss attacks.

## Requirements
- Complete playable game with no clarification questions.
- Mobile movement joystick plus Fire and Parry buttons; Parry also uses Shift.
- Rainbow Omni Rook with a rainbow trail and additional attack patterns.

## Decisions
- The game is an arcade boss fight, not standard chess.
- Parry briefly protects the player and deflects nearby projectiles toward the boss.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented touch joystick, Fire and Parry buttons, and Shift parry input.
- Added parry timing, projectile deflection and damage, visual feedback, and score rewards.
- Added a rainbow-gradient Omni Rook and a fading rainbow trail.
- Added volley, cross, and spiral attacks with telegraphs, alongside the existing line and burst attacks.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Browser-test the latest mobile controls, parry behavior, rainbow visuals, and new attacks.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run the game in a browser and verify desktop and mobile interactions, attack telegraphs, and parry/reflection behavior.
2. Fix any issues discovered during browser testing.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, mobile input, parry, boss attacks, and drawing.
- `index.html`: Touch-control UI and keyboard control hints.
- `style.css`: Responsive touch-control layout and styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Recent edits have not yet been browser-tested.

## Objective
- Build a playable chessboard-themed arcade boss fight: a king with a shotgun versus the Omni Rook.
- Browser-test desktop and mobile controls, parrying, rainbow visuals, and boss attacks.

## Requirements
- Complete playable game with no clarification questions.
- Mobile movement joystick plus Fire and Parry buttons; Parry also uses Shift.
- Rainbow Omni Rook with a rainbow trail and additional attack patterns.

## Decisions
- The game is an arcade boss fight, not standard chess.
- Parry briefly protects the player and deflects nearby projectiles toward the boss.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented touch joystick, Fire and Parry buttons, and Shift parry input.
- Added parry timing, projectile deflection and damage, visual feedback, and score rewards.
- Added a rainbow-gradient Omni Rook and a fading rainbow trail.
- Added volley, cross, and spiral attacks with telegraphs, alongside line and burst attacks.
- Fixed pause overlay crash by adding the missing `#overlayHint` element; clicking the overlay button while paused now resumes instead of restarting.
- Desktop browser checks confirmed firing damages the boss, consumes ammo, parry displays feedback, and pause/resume works.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Complete browser testing of mobile joystick, Fire and Parry controls, and boss attack telegraphs/reflection behavior.

### Blocked
- Synthetic mobile Fire test called `setPointerCapture` without a real active pointer, causing `NotFoundError: Failed to execute 'setPointerCapture' on 'Element': No active pointer with the given id is found.` Test with genuine touch input or another valid pointer simulation.

## Next Move
1. Test mobile controls using actual touch input or Playwright pointer actions with active pointers; verify joystick movement and Fire/Parry interactions.
2. Observe attack telegraphs and confirm reflected projectiles damage the boss; fix any issues found.
3. Re-run `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, mobile input, parry, boss attacks, and drawing.
- `index.html`: Touch-control UI, overlay, and keyboard hints.
- `style.css`: Responsive touch-control layout and styling.

## Important Context
- Changes to `game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css` are uncommitted.
- Local HTTP server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Playwright browser installation completed; desktop browser session opened successfully.
- Mobile viewport test showed touch controls displayed at 390×844; synthetic pointer dispatch failed because the pointer was not active.
